title: 第9章 聚元三层第10章 全部废掉
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏铭心中那叫一个无语，这林念瑶胆子也忒肥了吧！居然又给自己下药，而且这儿可是野外啊，她怎么敢的！
“这女人，真让人头疼！”苏铭在心底暗自叫苦。
林念瑶再次将苏铭压制，那楚楚可怜的模样瞬间消失不见，取而代之的是上次那般强势。
但不得不说，林念瑶身材婀娜多姿，曲线玲珑，脸蛋更是绝美，犹如仙子下凡，倾国倾城。这般诱惑，世间又有几人能扛得住？
林念瑶眼神迷离，轻声呢喃：“我也不知为何，就是特别想与你在一起，那种感觉，我怀念得紧。”
苏铭瞪大了眼睛，满是震惊与愤怒，忍不住惊呼道：“怀念就大大方方说，搞什么下药这一出啊？你这不是乱来嘛！”
……
一夜悄然流逝。
苏铭悠悠转醒，只觉身体似被抽干了力气，有些发虚。
瞧去，林念瑶正趴在他身上，睡得香甜，模样乖巧至极。
苏铭心中满是震撼，实在难以将眼前这温顺模样，与昨晚那疯狂的她联系到一起。
忽地，苏铭心中一动，惊觉自己这些天停滞不前的修为，似有突破之象？
他当下不敢迟疑，赶忙盘膝而坐，运转起功法。
刹那间，周身气息涌动，他心中狂喜，没错，真的突破了！从凝气九层，竟直接跨越三层，突破到了聚元三层！
“我去！这跨度也太夸张了吧！”苏铭内心满是不可置信，震惊得无以复加。
“难道说，这便是阴阳神诀的神奇功效？”苏铭喃喃自语，眼中满是兴奋与疑惑交织的光芒。
林念瑶悠悠转醒。
她双颊绯红，恰似天边绚丽晚霞，透着丝丝娇羞。
她眼眸轻垂，根本不敢直视苏铭。
可眼角余光，还是瞥见了苏铭的不同。

“天啊！”林念瑶心中惊呼，“苏铭竟突破到聚元境了！”那震撼，如巨石投入平静湖面，掀起千层浪。
林念瑶这时，也察觉到自身变化。
“怪哉！”她满心诧异，“我竟从凝气五层，一举跃至凝气七层！”
上次从四层突破到五层时，她还满心以为，是自己日夜苦修的功劳。
可如今这般接连突破，再联想方才种种，“难不成，是因为和苏铭……”林念瑶心思百转，脸颊愈发滚烫，心中也泛起了更多旖旎的念头。
两人回去的路上，苏铭脸色阴沉，目光如电，紧紧盯着身旁的林念瑶，寒声道：
“听好了，莫要仗着你是我的女人，便肆意妄为，行事毫无顾忌。这世间，可不是你能随性撒野的地方。”
林念瑶美目流转，眼波如水，嘴角轻扬，挂着一抹迷人笑意，柔声道：
“苏铭哥哥，瞧你说的，我哪敢呀，定是听你的话。”
可那低垂的眼眸深处，一抹狡黠光芒悄然闪过，恰似夜空中划过的诡异流星。她心中暗自盘算：“哼，苏铭，你以为能这般轻易束缚住我？我自有我的打算，你呀就乖乖的受着吧！”
苏圣杰神色凝重，对苏铭说道：“铭儿，明日便是洛安城四大家族的天才战。”
“此役，关乎接下来洛安城势力范围内所有资源的分配，极为关键。”
“我听闻，秦家为针对我苏家，竟联合了林家和万家。”
content_en:
Su Ming was speechless in his heart. Lin Nianyao must be too courageous! She actually drugged herself again, and this was a wild place, how dare she!
"This woman is really a headache!" Su Ming complained secretly in his heart.
Lin Nianyao suppressed Su Ming again, and the pitiful appearance disappeared in an instant, replaced by the strong one from last time.
But it has to be said that Lin Nianyao has a graceful figure, curvy figures, and an even more beautiful face. She is like a fairy descending to earth and enchanting the country. How many people in the world can withstand such temptation?
Lin Nianyao's eyes were blurry and she murmured softly: "I don't know why, but I just really want to be with you. I miss that feeling very much."
Su Ming's eyes widened, full of shock and anger, and he couldn't help but exclaimed: "If you miss me, just say it openly, why are you drugged? Aren't you just messing around!"
…
The night passed quietly.
Su Ming woke up slowly and felt that his body seemed to have been drained of strength and felt a little weak.
Looking over, Lin Nianyao was lying on top of him, sleeping soundly and looking extremely well-behaved.
Su Ming's heart was filled with shock, and it was really difficult to connect the meek look in front of him with the crazy look she had last night.
Suddenly, Su Ming felt something in his heart. He was shocked to realize that his stagnant cultivation these days seemed to be making a breakthrough?
He did not dare to hesitate at the moment, and hurriedly sat cross-legged and started to use the technique.
In an instant, the aura around his body surged, and he was ecstatic. Yes, he really had a breakthrough! From the ninth level of Qi Condensation, he jumped directly across the third level and broke through to the third level of Juyuan!
"I'll go! This span is too exaggerated!" Su Ming was filled with disbelief and was extremely shocked.
"Could it be that this is the miraculous effect of the Yin-Yang Divine Art?" Su Ming murmured to himself, his eyes filled with excitement and doubt.
Lin Nianyao slowly woke up.
Her cheeks were crimson, just like the gorgeous sunset on the horizon, showing the slightest hint of shyness.
She lowered her eyes lightly, not daring to look directly at Su Ming.
But out of the corner of his eye, he still caught a glimpse of something different about Su Ming.
"Oh my God!" Lin Nianyao exclaimed in her heart, "Su Ming has actually broken through to the Juyuan Realm!" The shock was like a huge boulder thrown into a calm lake, causing thousands of waves.
At this time, Lin Nianyao also noticed changes in herself.
"How strange!" She was filled with surprise, "I actually jumped from the fifth level of Qi Condensation to the seventh level of Qi Condensation in one fell swoop!"
The last time she broke through from the fourth level to the fifth level, she still thought that it was the result of her hard work day and night.
But now with such continuous breakthroughs, and thinking about all the things just now, "Could it be because of Su Ming..." Lin Nianyao's mind was spinning, her cheeks were getting hotter, and more charming thoughts appeared in her heart.
On the way back, Su Ming's face was gloomy, his eyes were like lightning, he stared at Lin Nianyao beside him, and said in a cold voice:
"Listen, don't act recklessly and act without scruples just because you are my woman. This world is not a place where you can run wild as you please."
Lin Nianyao's beautiful eyes rolled around, her eyes were like water, the corners of her mouth were raised slightly, with a charming smile, and she said softly:
"Brother Su Ming, look at what you said, how dare I? I must listen to you."
But deep in those lowered eyes, a cunning light flashed quietly, just like a strange meteor streaking across the night sky. She was thinking secretly in her mind: "Hmph, Su Ming, do you think you can restrain me so easily? I have my own plans, so just accept it obediently!"
Su Shengjie looked solemn and said to Su Ming: "Ming'er, tomorrow will be a battle of geniuses between the four major families in Luo'an City."
"This battle is related to the subsequent distribution of all resources within Luo'an City's sphere of influence. It is extremely critical."
"I heard that the Qin family actually united with the Lin family and the Wan family to target our Su family."
